lead: Ravindra Jadeja has built a public profile as an Indian cricketer, born on 6 December 1988 in Navagam Ghed.
As of 2026, he is 37 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Saurashtra cricket team and has been recognised with the Arjuna Award.
This profile collects the Ravindra facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
